articles.summary: National Aluminium Company (Nalco) has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with Russia’s Rusal to research scandium recovery from red mud.

articles.title: Monedo Financial Services crosses ₹1,000 cr asset mark; eyes ₹5k cr in 2 yrs

articles.summary: Monedo Financial Services has reached a ₹1,000 crore asset milestone and is transitioning to a more stringent regulatory category.

timeline.text: Monedo has crossed ₹1,000 crore in assets and is moving from the Base Layer to the Middle Layer under RBI regulations.

articles.title: Gold recovers from one-year low as markets assess Fed rate outlook
articles.summary: Gold prices are rebounding as markets react to expectations of interest rate changes from central banks.
articles.explain: Gold is often used as a hedge against inflation. A 'basis point' is a standard unit of measure in finance, where 100 basis points equal 1 percent. When interest rates rise, gold usually becomes less attractive because it does not generate interest, so investors closely watch Federal Reserve signals to decide whether to buy or sell.

story.title: Global Currency Market Trends
